newsitem.title: UK: Sun Life up on talk Pru may increase stake.
newsitem.headline: Sun Life up on talk Pru may increase stake.

text.p: Sun Life & Provincial Holdings Plc shares rose on Wednesday after a report in French business paper Les Echos said there was speculation that Prudential Corp Plc may be interested in raising its stake in Sun Life.
Sun Life shares were up 10p at 273 by 1222 GMT while Prudential rose 3p to 499-1/2.

Following widespread speculation about the implications of the merger between UAP and AXA since it was announced last November, Les Echos said there was talk that the merged group may be overexposed in the UK.
The group will also control insurance group Axa Equity & Law in the UK and Les Echos said there was speculation about the possible interest of the Pru in increasing its stake in Sun Life.
After recent share purchases, the Pru already holds about nine percent of Sun Life Holdings, which is about a quarter of the free float in the stock.
Sources close to Sun Life said no decisions had been taken regarding the UK operations of the French group and that any suggestion that it may reduce its stake in Sun Life could only be speculation.
Sun Life was floated on the London Stock Exchange last June at 235p but UAP retained a controlling 60 percent stake.
